title: Rect Cassettes
description: Turns Minecraft music discs into retro-style cassette tapes for a classic vibe.
body:
Rect Cassettes - Java Edition

This resource pack for Minecraft Java Edition transforms the classic music discs into stylish retro cassettes, giving your jukebox collection a cool and nostalgic vibe.

Each disc now looks like a vintage cassette tape, making your music collection feel more unique and visually enhanced while keeping the original disc sounds untouched.

🎶 Here is a preview of a few designs — you can see more inside the pack. These images are just for showcase.

p>
